User.title: User
User.description: Represents an authenticated travel agency with registration information and developer management controls.

accountStatus.description: true for Active, false for Suspended

information.description: User registration information submitted by the agency operator.

management.description: Developer control fields: agencyCode (string), accountStatus (boolean: true for Active, false for Suspended), userName, activatedAt, lastLogin, expiresAt.

Trip.title: Trip
Trip.description: Represents a bus trip schedule with its seat booking layout status.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Agency counter settings and printing layouts.

/users/{userId}.description: Authenticated user profiles with information and management sub-objects.

/users/{userId}/trips/{tripId}.description: Completely user-isolated bus trips, routes, seat allocations, passenger records, and bookings for the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingsId}.description: Completely user-isolated agency preferences, bus branding, and printing configurations.
